blind_read: The monkey picks up one banana on the red side, takes it across, sets it down in the green basket and turns back.

evidence.observation: The empty green basket, loaded red basket and warm banana remain distinct after the coat changes color. The lifting foot changes height as the fruit crosses the body.

evidence.pose: 0.65 s and 1.34 s / placement and turn
evidence.observation: At placement the rear foot ends at a straight vertical edge; in the mirrored turnaround the trailing shin ends in a narrow stump next to the red basket. The rest of the feet in the approach drawings are broad.

blockers: Cropping cuts through the feet at placement and turnaround, visibly shortening the limbs.
